label: SmartNews Ads
terms_note: Developer application registered with SmartNews Ads (API Access Terms of Service); OAuth token generated per developer app; v2 fully disabled (410) — use v3. 'Requests are limited per developer app ID. Making too many requests in a short time will result in a 429 error.' Currency JPY (USD for the US edition). Free. Separate approval for the Conversion API.

discovery.auth: oauth2 (developer application → POST oauth token; bearer)

reference.verdict: **Verdict** — has_api: **yes** (SmartNews Marketing API v3.0.1) Confidence: **high** — official Redoc + official GitHub spec read.
auth: 1. Register a developer application with SmartNews Ads (agree to the SmartNews Ads API Access Terms of Service).
2. `POST …/oauth/token` — 'Generate an access token' for the developer application; revoke with the companion endpoint.
3. `Authorization: Bearer <token>`; list the ad accounts linked to the developer app (`GET …/developer-app/ad-accounts`).

endpoints.purpose: ad accounts associated with the developer app

endpoints.notes: ad_account_id, name, objective, budget, start/end, status
campaign_id, name, bid_amount, daily_budget, targeting{locations, interests, article_categories, custom_audiences}, schedule

endpoints.purpose: pixels (conversion tracking); Conversion API is separately approved

reference.limits: - Rate limit per developer app ID (429 on burst); currency JPY (US edition USD); 'Simultaneous Update Operation Limitation'; API Access Terms of Service (ads.smartnews.com/developers/tos-us.html).
mcp_sdk: Official OpenAPI download on the Redoc page; official GitHub spec repo (smartnews/smartnews-ads-advertising-api-spec).

fields.name: client_id
fields.help: Developer app id (numeric client id) of an approved SmartNews Ads developer application.

fields.name: client_secret
fields.help: The developer app's client secret; access tokens (scope ads-manager) last 24 hours and are re-requested automatically.

config_fields.name: ad_account_id
config_fields.help: SmartNews ad account id used by pause_resume (the campaign PATCH path is /api/ma/v3/ad_accounts/{ad_account_id}/campaigns/{campaign_id}).

me.note: GET /api/bm/v1/developer_apps/me/ad_accounts: confirms the developer app token and lists the ad accounts linked to it.

list_accounts.note: Ad accounts associated with the developer app ({ad_account_id, ad_account_name, owner_business_id, roles}); no currency on this record.

list_campaigns.note: GET /api/ma/v3/ad_accounts/{ad_account_id}/campaigns (page/page_size). Budgets are micros of the account currency: budget_micros is daily_budget_amount_micro (1,000,000 = 1 USD or 1 JPY). `status` is configured_status and is not a filter; raw.delivery_status shows serving.

get_report.note: GET /api/ma/v3/ad_accounts/{ad_account_id}/insights/campaigns?since=date_fromT00:00:00Z&until=date_toT23:59:59Z&fields=... (optionally target_ids=campaign_id): one row per campaign with totals over the range (viewable impressions, clicks, spend in the account currency). Only Ads Manager v2 objects are reported; first 100 campaigns.

pause_resume.note: PATCH /api/ma/v3/ad_accounts/{ad_account_id config}/campaigns/{campaign_id} (application/merge-patch+json) {configured_status: PAUSED|ACTIVE}. Resuming restarts spending.

not_offered.update_budget: SmartNews budgets are micros ("daily_budget_amount_micro: The average budget per day in micros of the ad account currency base unit", PATCH /api/ma/v3/ad_accounts/{ad_account_id}/campaigns/{campaign_id}, https://ads.smartnews.com/developers/#tag/campaign/operation/patchCampaignById); the adapter cannot scale a daily_budget into micros.

evidence: probe: 5/5 tools answered on their documented path with an auth refusal, a validation error or data; control route -> 404 (not_found), so the answers are path-specific
HTML docs spot-check (render-doc): 4/5 tool paths found verbatim on their docs pages; every parameter and body key named on the page
